kv2.9:5.1: Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dukkhadassanena kiṃ jahatīti?
kv2.9:5.2: Sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ vicikicchaṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ tadekaṭṭhe ca kilese catubhāgaṃ jahatīti.
kv2.9:5.3: Catubhāgaṃ sotāpanno, catubhāgaṃ na sotāpanno; catubhāgaṃ sotāpattiphalappatto paṭiladdho adhigato sacchikato upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharati, catubhāgaṃ na kāyena phusitvā viharati; catubhāgaṃ sattakkhattuparamo, kolaṃkolo, ekabījī, Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato, Dhamme --pe-- Saṃghe --pe-- ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato, catubhāgaṃ na ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato ti?
kv2.9:6.4: Sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ vicikicchaṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ tadekaṭṭhe ca kilese catubhāgaṃ jahatīti.
kv2.9:6.5: Catubhāgaṃ sotāpanno, catubhāgaṃ na sotāpanno; catubhāgaṃ sotāpattiphalappatto paṭiladdho adhigato sacchikato upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharati, catubhāgaṃ na kāyena phusitvā viharati; catubhāgaṃ sattakkhattuparamo, kolaṃkolo, ekabījī, Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato, Dhamme --pe-- Saṃghe --pe-- ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato, catubhāgaṃ na ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato ti?
kv2.9:7.1: Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dukkhadassanena kiṃ jahatīti?
kv2.9:7.2: Oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ tadekaṭṭhe ca kilese catubhāgaṃ jahatīti.
kv2.9:7.3: Catubhāgaṃ sakadāgāmī, catubhāgaṃ na sakadāgāmī; catubhāgaṃ sakadāgāmiphalappatto paṭiladdho adhigato sacchikato upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharati, catubhāgaṃ na kāyena phusitvā viharatīti?
kv2.9:7.8: Oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ tad ekaṭṭhe ca kilese catubhāgaṃ jahatīti.
kv2.9:7.9: Catubhāgaṃ sakadāgāmī, catubhāgaṃ na sakadāgāmī; catubhāgaṃ sakadāgāmiphalappatto paṭiladdho adhigato sacchikato upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharati, catubhāgaṃ na kāyena phusitvā viharatīti?
kv2.9:8.1: Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dukkhadassanena kiṃ jahatīti?
kv2.9:8.2: Aṇusahagataṃ kāmarāgaṃ aṇusahagataṃ byāpādaṃ tadekaṭṭhe ca kilese catubhāgaṃ jahatīti.
kv2.9:8.3: Catubhāgaṃ anāgāmī, catubhāgaṃ na anāgāmī; catubhāgaṃ anāgāmiphalappatto paṭiladdho adhigato sacchikato upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharati, catubhāgaṃ na kāyena phusitvā viharati; catubhāgaṃ antarāparinibbāyī --pe-- upahaccaparinibbāyī --pe-- asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī --pe-- sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī -- pe uddhaṃsoto akaniṭṭhagāmī, catubhāgaṃ na uddhaṃsoto na akaniṭṭhagāmī ti?
kv2.9:9.4: Aṇusahagataṃ kāmarāgaṃ aṇusahagataṃ byāpādaṃ tadekaṭṭhe ca kilese catubhāgaṃ jahatīti.
kv2.9:9.5: Catubhāgaṃ anāgāmī, catubhāgaṃ na anāgāmī; catubhāgaṃ anāgāmiphalappatto paṭiladdho adhigato sacchikato upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharati, catubhāgaṃ na kāyena phusitvā viharati; catubhāgaṃ antarāparinibbāyī --pe-- upahaccaparinibbāyī --pe-- asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī --pe-- sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyī -- pe -- uddhaṃsoto akaniṭṭhagāmī, catubhāgaṃ na uddhaṃsoto
kv2.9:9.6: na akaniṭṭhagāmī ti? Na h' evaṃ vattabbe --pe-- 9.
kv2.9:10.1: Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dukkhadassanena kiṃ jahatīti?
kv2.9:10.2: Rūparāgaṃ arūparāgaṃ mānaṃ uddhaccaṃ avijjaṃ tadekaṭṭhe ca kilese catubhāgaṃ jahatīti.
kv2.9:10.3: Catubhāgaṃ Arahā, catubhāgaṃ na Arahā; catubhāgaṃ arahattappatto paṭiladdho adhigato sacchikato upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharati, catubhāgaṃ na kāyena phusitvā viharati; catubhāgaṃ vītarāgo vītadoso vītamoho katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto ukkhittapaligho saṃkiṇṇaparikho abbuḷhesiko niraggalo ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaññuto suvijitavijayo, dukkhan tassa pariññātaṃ, samudayo pahīno, nirodho sacchikato, maggo bhāvito, abhiññeyyaṃ abhiññātaṃ, pariññeyyaṃ pariññātaṃ, pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ, bhāvetabbaṃ bhāvitaṃ --pe-- sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikataṃ, catubhāgaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ na sacchikatan ti?
kv2.9:11.2: Rūparāgaṃ arūparāgaṃ mānaṃ uddhaccaṃ avijjaṃ tadekaṭṭhe ca kilese catubhāgaṃ jahatīti.
kv2.9:11.3: Catubhāgaṃ Arahā, catubhāgaṃ na Arahā; catubhāgaṃ arahattappatto paṭiladdho adhigato sacchikato upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharati, catubhāgaṃ na kāyena phusitvā viharati; catubhāgaṃ vītarāgo vītadoso vītamoho katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto ukkhittapaligho saṃkiṇṇaparikho abbuḷhesiko niraggalo ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaññutto suvijitavijayo, dukkhan tassa pariññātaṃ, samudayo pahīno, nirodho sacchikato, maggo bhāvito, abhiññeyyaṃ abhiññātaṃ, pariññeyyaṃ pariññātaṃ, pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ, bhāvetabbaṃ bhāvitaṃ --pe-- sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikataṃ, catubhāgaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ na sachikatan ti?
kv2.9:12.1: Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dukkhaṃ dakkhanto "paṭipannako ti" vattabbo ti?
kv2.9:12.3: Dukkhe diṭṭhe "phale ṭhito ti" vattabbo ti?
kv2.9:12.8: Nirodhe diṭṭhe "phale ṭhito ti" vattabbo ti?
kv2.9:13.1: Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo maggaṃ dakkhanto "paṭipannako ti" vattabbo, magge diṭṭhe "phale ṭhito ti" vattabbo ti?
kv2.9:13.3: Dukkhaṃ dakkhanto "paṭipannako ti" vattabbo, dukkhe diṭṭhe "phale ṭhito ti" vattabbo ti?
kv2.9:13.5: Maggaṃ dakkhanto "paṭipannako ti" vattabbo, magge diṭṭhe "phale ṭhito ti" vattabbo ti?
kv2.9:13.8: nirodhaṃ dakkhanto "paṭipannako ti" vattabbo, nirodhe diṭṭhe "phale ṭhito ti" vattabbo ti?
kv2.9:14.1: Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dukkhaṃ dakkhanto "paṭipannako ti" vattabbo, dukkhe diṭṭhe na vattabbaṃ
kv2.9:14.4: Maggaṃ dakkhanto "paṭipannako ti" vattabbo, magge diṭṭhe na vattabbaṃ
kv2.9:15.7: nirodhaṃ dakkhanto "paṭipannako ti" vattabbo, nirodhe diṭṭhe na vattabbaṃ
kv2.9:15.8: "phale ṭhito ti" vattabbo ti? Āmantā. Maggaṃ dakkhanto "paṭipannako ti" vattabbo, magge diṭṭhe na vattabbaṃ "phale ṭhito ti" vattabbo ti? Na h' evaṃ vattabbe --pe-- 13. Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dukkhaṃ dakkhanto "paṭipannako ti" vattabbo dukkhe diṭṭhe na vattabbaṃ "phale ṭhito ti" vattabbo ti?
kv2.9:15.11: Na h' evaṃ vattabbe --pe-- Samudayaṃ dakkhanto --pe-- nirodhaṃ dakkhanto "paṭipannako ti" vattabbo nirodhe diṭṭhe na vattabbaṃ "phale ṭhito ti" vattabbo ti? Āmantā. Niratthiyaṃ nirodhadassanan ti? Na h' evaṃ vattabbe --pe-- 14.
kv2.9:16.1: Dukkhe diṭṭhe cattāri saccāni diṭṭhāni hontīti?
kv2.9:17.1: Rūpakkhandhe aniccato diṭṭhe pañcakkhandhā aniccato diṭṭhā hontīti?
kv2.9:18.1: Cakkhāyatane aniccato diṭṭhe dvādasāyatanāni aniccato diṭṭhāni hontīti?
kv2.9:19.1: Cakkhudhātuyā aniccato diṭṭhāya aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo aniccato diṭṭhā hontīti?
kv2.9:20.1: Cakkhundriye aniccato diṭṭhe bāvīsatindriyāni aniccato diṭṭhāni hontīti?
kv2.9:22.5: "Seyyathāpi Bhikkhave mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyataken' eva papāto,
